purpose: Pre-registered additional support-seed replication after the original four-seed validation and before formal test evaluation.
selection_rule: Use the already validation-selected rho=0.5 without further tuning or seed selection; evaluate all 16 pre-specified seeds.
test_scope: Replicate fixed-parameter results with additional support draws on the same frozen Zhou test split; this is support-seed replication, not an additional independent test dataset.

sampling.rng: One isolated Python random.Random(seed) instance per seed
sampling.class_order: First encounter order in the frozen original Zhou train array, matching the original support manifest and official HyCal tracker.items()
sampling.within_class_order: Original Zhou train array order, without sorting or shuffling
sampling.algorithm: Traverse classes once, rng.sample(train_items, 10); take each class draw[:5]; concatenate in class encounter order
sampling.cross_seed_overlap: Allowed and expected because each seed independently draws from the same fixed training pool; duplicate sample IDs are forbidden within each seed.
